listFilesToObservationPayload.timestamp: phenomenonTime if rawItem mode is adopted
listFilesToObservationPayload.string array newest item: filename parsing source for current runtime

documentOnlyFields.fs: useful file-size signal, currently best kept out of the result body
documentOnlyFields.newestImageDT: useful availability signal, currently best treated as metadata
documentOnlyFields.hideCam: selection and inventory field, not currently part of the observation contract

importantCaveat: Site-based discovery can return multiple cameras for one NWIS site. The current publisher model selects one camera per shared station system and does not yet generalize to many-camera-per-site publication.
